label: Bible Study
prompt: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly _____:
verse: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
note: A merchant finds one pearl of great price — and sells everything to get it.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a _____, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
verse: But the God of all grace, who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after that ye have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
note: Suffering lasts 'a while'; God's eternal glory lasts forever — and He'll make you strong in between.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the _____ of righteousness;
verse: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
note: The armour of God: truth as the belt, righteousness as the breastplate — a Sunday school costume with a point.

label: Deep Water
prompt: God setteth the _____ in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
verse: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
note: God's homemaking: he places the lonely in families and leads prisoners out.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: O foolish Galatians, who hath _____ you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
verse: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
note: 'O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you?' — Paul at his most exasperated with a church he founded.
